entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: Climactic ritual in 4562 AR in which the clan khans summoned five spirit dragons to overthrow the dragonlords.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Former planeswalker who led the ritual and became Waymaster of the Jeskai Way.

entities.name: Alniul
entities.description: Temur figure who helped Narset find the ritual scroll.

entities.name: Dragonlords
entities.description: Rulers of Tarkir defeated by the ritual.

entities.name: Crucible of the Spirit Dragon
entities.description: Ruins where the ritual was performed.

events.summary: Narset and Alniul uncover a faded scroll for the Stormnexus Ritual; Narset is persuaded to use it.
events.quote: she was persuaded by the other rebellion leaders that it was the only way to unify the plane

events.summary: The khans perform the ritual at the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon, raising five spirit dragons bound to them.
events.quote: Narset shaped the first into Shiko

events.summary: The dragonlords try to stop the ritual and are defeated and swallowed by the storm.
events.quote: Ultimately, the dragonlords were defeated and seemingly swallowed by the massive storm.

events.summary: Narset is appointed Waymaster of the Jeskai Way and the other khans lead their clans with their spirit dragons.
events.quote: Narset was appointed Waymaster of the Jeskai Way

relations.note: linked to its summoner as spiritual leader
relations.quote: each dragon was linked to their summoner
